headline: Sensex Surges 1,233 Points as Reliance Rally and Lower Oil Prices Drive Massive Market Gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sharp rally in Reliance Industries shares following earnings reports
Significant decline in global crude oil prices boosting market sentiment
Positive global cues with US stock futures rising as AI stocks stabilize
Strong domestic buying interest leading to a recovery of over 1,200 points in the Sensex
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty 50 surged over 1%, with Nifty reclaiming the 23,400 mark
ITC reported an 18-20% drop in Q2 net profit despite a 44% jump in revenue
Coforge reached a 52-week high, marking a 15% rally within a single month
The market rally resulted in an investor wealth increase of approximately Rs 6 lakh crore
summary: Indian benchmark indices witnessed a massive rally on Monday, with the Sensex surging 1,233 points and Nifty reclaiming 23,400. The gains were primarily driven by a sharp rally in Reliance Industries and a significant decline in global crude oil prices. While Coforge hit a 52-week high, ITC reported a nearly 20% decline in quarterly profit despite higher revenues.
